records.literal_gloss: For the director, with stringed instruments. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director: with stringed instruments. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. With stringed instruments. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To be played on stringed instruments. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : avec instruments à cordes. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Avec instruments à cordes. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. À jouer sur des instruments à cordes. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa ala za nyuzi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa ala za nyuzi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ipigwe kwa ala za nyuzi. Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: con instrumentos de cuerda. Salmo de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Con instrumentos de cuerda. Salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Para tocarse con instrumentos de cuerda. Canto de David.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
alternatives: for the end (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The word (menatseach) is a form of a verb meaning to lead or oversee; 1 Chronicles 15:21 uses the verb for Levites who led the singing with lyres. It stands at the head of 55 psalms, probably marking the psalm for the leader of the temple music. The ancient Greek translation read it differently, as "for the end".

decisions.choice: stringed instruments: to be accompanied on strings
decisions.reason: The word (neginot) is used for music played on strings (Habakkuk 3:19 ends with the same note). It tells how the psalm was to be performed.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1, Readable says what a psalm is.

decisions.choice: "Au chef de chœur" (Literal, Balanced), "Pour le chef des musiciens" (Readable), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The word names the one who leads the music in worship (m2); its exact sense is not certain. French uses a plain modern title, and Readable says what he does, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya" (L, B); "Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji" (R), in every title that has lamnatseach
decisions.reason: The word names the one who leads the temple music (m2). "Kiongozi wa kwaya" is the plain modern phrase for a choir leader; Readable says "waimbaji" (singers), a word every reader knows.

decisions.choice: Al director del coro (L, B); Para el director de la música (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lamnatseach names the one who led the temple music. Literal and Balanced say "Al director del coro", Readable "Para el director de la música", the same in every psalm title that has the word.

source.text: בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי׀אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: When I call, answer me, God of my righteousness! In the distress you made room for me; be gracious to me and hear my prayer.

en.L: When I call, answer me, God of my righteousness! In [the] distress {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made room for me; be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
en.B: When I call, answer me, God who stands up for my right! When I was hemmed in, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave me room. Show me grace now and listen to my prayer.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who shows that I am in the right. Please answer when I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! When I was in trouble, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set me free. Be kind to me now and hear my prayer.

fr.L: Quand j’appelle, réponds-moi, Dieu de ma justice ! Dans la détresse, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as mis au large ; fais-moi grâce et écoute ma prière.
fr.B: Quand j’appelle, réponds-moi, Dieu qui défends mon droit ! Quand j’étais à l’étroit, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as donné de l’espace. Fais-moi grâce maintenant, écoute ma prière.
fr.R: Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui montres que j’ai raison. Réponds-moi quand je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle ! Quand j’étais en difficulté, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as libéré. Sois bon pour moi maintenant et écoute ma prière.

sw.L: Ninapoita, unijibu, Ee Mungu wa haki yangu! Katika dhiki umenipa nafasi; unifanyie neema na usikie maombi yangu.
sw.B: Ninapoita, unijibu, Ee Mungu unayetetea haki yangu! Nilipobanwa, ulinipa nafasi. Unihurumie sasa na usikilize maombi yangu.
sw.R: Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye unayeonyesha kwamba niko sahihi. Tafadhali unijibu ninapokuita! Nilipokuwa taabuni, uliniweka huru. Unionee huruma sasa na usikie maombi yangu.

es.L: Cuando clamo, ¡respóndeme, Dios de mi justicia! En [la] angustia {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has dado espacio; ten piedad de mí y escucha mi oración.
es.B: Cuando clamo, ¡respóndeme, Dios que defiendes mi derecho! Cuando estaba acorralado, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me diste espacio. Muéstrame ahora {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gracia y escucha mi oración.
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres quien muestra que yo tengo la razón. ¡Por favor, respóndeme cuando {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} llamo! Cuando estaba en problemas, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me liberaste. Sé bondadoso conmigo ahora y escucha mi oración.

decisions.choice: God of my righteousness: the God who upholds my right
decisions.reason: Righteousness (tsedeq) here is being in the right, as in a court. The psalmist is falsely accused (verse 3) and appeals to the God who will show that he is in the right. The phrase may also mean simply "my righteous God".

decisions.choice: in distress you made room for me: set me free from a tight place
decisions.reason: Distress (tsar) is a narrow, tight place; to make room (rachab) is to make it wide. Being rescued is pictured as being brought out into open space (Psalm 18:20).

decisions.choice: you have made room: what God has done before
decisions.reason: The verb is in the past form between two requests. It most likely recalls an earlier rescue, the ground for asking again; some read it as a request.

decisions.choice: God who stands up for my right (B); the one who shows that I am in the right (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means here (m1); Literal keeps its form.

source.text: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Sons of man, until when [will] my honor [be] for shame? [Will] you love emptiness, seek falsehood? Selah.

en.L: Sons of man, how long [will] my glory [be turned] into shame? [How long] will you love emptiness [and] seek falsehood? Selah
en.B: You people, how long will my honor be dragged into disgrace? How long will you love empty things and go looking for lies? Selah
en.R: You people, how long will you insult me and bring me shame? How long will you love worthless things and go after lies? Selah

fr.L: Fils d’homme, jusqu’à quand ma gloire [sera-t-elle changée] en honte ? [Jusqu’à quand] aimerez-vous le vide [et] chercherez-vous le mensonge ? Sélah
fr.B: Vous, les gens, jusqu’à quand mon honneur sera-t-il traîné dans la honte ? Jusqu’à quand aimerez-vous ce qui est vain et courrez-vous après le mensonge ? Sélah
fr.R: Vous, les gens, jusqu’à quand allez-vous m’insulter et me couvrir de honte ? Jusqu’à quand aimerez-vous ce qui ne vaut rien et courrez-vous après les mensonges ? Sélah

sw.L: Enyi wana wa binadamu, hata lini utukufu wangu [utageuzwa] kuwa aibu? [Hata lini] mtapenda ubatili [na] kutafuta uongo? Sela
sw.B: Enyi watu, hata lini heshima yangu itaburutwa katika fedheha? Hata lini mtapenda mambo yasiyo na maana na kutafuta uongo? Sela
sw.R: Enyi watu, hata lini mtanitukana na kuniaibisha? Hata lini mtapenda mambo yasiyofaa kitu na kufuata uongo? Sela

es.L: Hijos de hombre, ¿hasta cuándo [será] mi gloria [convertida] en vergüenza? ¿[Hasta cuándo] {{plural_you:amarán|amaréis}} la vaciedad [y] {{plural_you:buscarán|buscaréis}} la mentira? Selah
es.B: Oh gente, ¿hasta cuándo será arrastrada mi honra a la deshonra? ¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:amarán|amaréis}} las cosas vacías e {{plural_you:irán|iréis}} tras las mentiras? Selah
es.R: Gente, ¿hasta cuándo me {{plural_you:insultarán|insultaréis}} y me {{plural_you:avergonzarán|avergonzaréis}}? ¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:amarán|amaréis}} lo que no vale nada e {{plural_you:irán|iréis}} tras las mentiras? Selah

decisions.choice: sons of man: you people, perhaps men of standing
decisions.reason: The phrase (bene 'ish) is addressed to the psalmist's opponents. Psalm 49:3 sets it beside another phrase for people in a way that may mean "high and low", so these may be men of rank who are attacking his honor.

decisions.choice: my glory: my honor, my good name
decisions.reason: The word (kavod) is the one used in 3:4, "my glory": a person's weight and standing. His opponents are trying to shame him.

decisions.choice: emptiness, falsehood: worthless things and lies
decisions.reason: Emptiness (riq) is the word of 2:1, plans with nothing in them; falsehood (kazav) is a lie. They may be the slanders against the psalmist, or, as "lies" means in Amos 2:4, false gods.

decisions.choice: honor
decisions.reason: Balanced says "honor" because the sense here is reputation (m2); Literal keeps "glory", as in 3:4.

decisions.choice: how long will you insult me and bring me shame
alternatives: how long will my glory be turned into shame
decisions.reason: Readable makes the opponents the subject, which the question implies.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

source.text: וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And know that YHWH has set apart [the] faithful [one] for himself; YHWH hears when I call to him.

en.L: And know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has set apart [the] faithful one for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hears when I call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Be sure of this: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has set apart the one who is faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will hear me when I call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Know this: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen the person who is loyal to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hears me when I call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Et sachez que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a mis à part [le] fidèle pour {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} entend quand je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelle.
fr.B: Sachez-le bien : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a mis à part celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est fidèle, comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bien. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’entendra quand je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellerai.
fr.R: Sachez ceci : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a choisi celui qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est loyal pour qu’il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartienne. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’entend quand je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelle.

sw.L: Na jueni kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemtenga mwaminifu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} husikia ninapomwita.
sw.B: Jueni hakika: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemtenga yule aliye mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} kuwa mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atanisikia ninapomwita.
sw.R: Jueni hili: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemchagua mtu aliye mwaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ananisikia ninapomwita.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha apartado [al] fiel para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} oye cuando clamo a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Estén seguros|Estad seguros}} de esto: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha apartado como {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}} al que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} es fiel. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me escuchará cuando clame a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sepan|Sabed}} esto: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha escogido para que sea {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}} a la persona que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} es leal. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me oye cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llamo.

decisions.choice: set apart: made distinct, marked out
decisions.reason: The verb (palah) is used for the LORD making a distinction between Israel and Egypt (Exodus 9:4; 11:7). The faithful person belongs to the LORD and is treated differently.

decisions.choice: the faithful one: one who is loyal to God
decisions.reason: The word (chasid) comes from the word for steadfast, loyal love (chesed). It is the person who keeps faith with God. The psalmist means himself, but what he says is true of anyone who is faithful.

decisions.choice: faithful to him (B); loyal to him (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say to whom the person is faithful (m2).

source.text: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Tremble, and do not sin; speak in your heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

en.L: Tremble, and do not sin; speak in your heart on your bed, and be silent. Selah
en.B: Tremble, and do not sin. Lying on your bed, reason it out in your own heart, and be still. Selah
en.R: Shake with fear, and stop sinning. When you lie down at night, think hard about this and be quiet. Selah

fr.L: Tremblez et ne péchez pas ; dites-[le] dans votre cœur, sur votre lit, et restez silencieux. Sélah
fr.B: Tremblez, et ne péchez pas. Couchés sur votre lit, réfléchissez au fond de vous-mêmes, et restez tranquilles. Sélah
fr.R: Tremblez de peur, et arrêtez de pécher. Le soir, quand vous êtes couchés, réfléchissez bien à cela et restez calmes. Sélah

sw.L: Tetemekeni, wala msitende dhambi; semeni mioyoni mwenu vitandani mwenu, na nyamazeni. Sela
sw.B: Tetemekeni, wala msitende dhambi. Mkiwa mmelala vitandani mwenu, tafakarini mioyoni mwenu, na mtulie. Sela
sw.R: Tetemekeni kwa hofu, na acheni kutenda dhambi. Mnapolala usiku, fikirini sana juu ya jambo hili na mnyamaze. Sela

es.L: {{plural_you:Estremézcanse|Estremeceos}} y no {{plural_you:pequen|pequéis}}; {{plural_you:digan|decid}} en {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}, sobre {{plural_you:su lecho|vuestro lecho}}, y {{plural_you:guarden silencio|guardad silencio}}. Selah
es.B: {{plural_you:Tiemblen|Temblad}} y no {{plural_you:pequen|pequéis}}. Acostados en {{plural_you:su cama|vuestra cama}}, {{plural_you:piénsenlo bien|pensadlo bien}} en {{plural_you:su interior|vuestro interior}}, y {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} quietos. Selah
es.R: {{plural_you:Tiemblen|Temblad}} de miedo y {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} de pecar. Cuando {{plural_you:se acuesten|os acostéis}} por la noche, {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} bien en esto y {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} callados. Selah

decisions.choice: tremble: shake with fear
decisions.reason: The verb (ragaz) means to shake or be stirred, with fear or with anger. Here the opponents are told to stand in awe of the LORD and stop. The ancient Greek translation has "be angry, and do not sin", the words Paul quotes in Ephesians 4:26.

decisions.choice: speak in your heart: think it over
decisions.reason: To speak in one's heart is to think, to reason with oneself (Genesis 17:17). The night, alone on one's bed, is the time for it.

decisions.choice: be silent: be still, stop
decisions.reason: The verb (damam) means to be silent or still: the opponents should end their accusations.

decisions.choice: Shake with fear
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of trembling is meant (m1).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: Sacrifice sacrifices of righteousness, and trust in YHWH.

en.L: Sacrifice sacrifices of righteousness, and trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Bring sacrifices as they should be brought, and rely on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Bring your offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the right way, and trust in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Sacrifiez des sacrifices de justice, et faites confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Offrez des sacrifices comme il faut les offrir, et comptez sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Apportez vos offrandes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de la bonne manière, et faites-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} confiance.

sw.L: Toeni dhabihu za haki, na mtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Leteni dhabihu kama zinavyopaswa kuletwa, na mtegemee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mleteeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka zenu kwa njia iliyo sahihi, na kumtumaini.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ofrezcan|Ofreced}} sacrificios de justicia, y {{plural_you:confíen|confiad}} en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Presenten|Presentad}} los sacrificios como se deben presentar, y {{plural_you:apóyense|apoyaos}} en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Traigan|Traed}} {{plural_you:sus ofrendas|vuestras ofrendas}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de la manera correcta, y {{plural_you:confíen|confiad}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

decisions.choice: sacrifices of righteousness: sacrifices offered rightly
decisions.reason: The phrase (zivche tsedeq) is used in Deuteronomy 33:19 and Psalm 51:21: sacrifices offered in the right way, by people who are right with God. A sacrifice without trust in the LORD is not what he asks.

decisions.choice: Sacrifice ... trust: still spoken to the opponents
decisions.reason: The commands continue those of verse 5: the people who shamed the psalmist are told to turn to the LORD.

decisions.choice: Bring sacrifices as they should be brought
decisions.reason: Balanced says what makes the sacrifices right (m1).

source.text: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־יַרְאֵ֪נ֫וּט֥וֹב נְֽסָה־עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Many [are] saying, Who will show us good? Lift up on us the light of your face, YHWH.

en.L: Many [are] saying, "Who will show us good?" Lift up on us the light of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Many are saying, "Who will let us see good times?" {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} shining face toward us.
en.R: Many people ask, "Who will give us good things?" {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, smile on us and be kind to us.

fr.L: Nombreux [sont ceux qui] disent : « Qui nous fera voir le bonheur ? » Lève sur nous la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !
fr.B: Beaucoup disent : « Qui nous fera connaître des jours heureux ? » {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tourne vers nous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} visage lumineux !
fr.R: Beaucoup de gens demandent : « Qui nous donnera de bonnes choses ? » {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, souris-nous et sois bon pour nous.

sw.L: Wengi wanasema, "Ni nani atakayetuonyesha mema?" Uinue juu yetu nuru ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Wengi wanasema, "Ni nani atakayetuonyesha siku njema?" Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uelekeze kwetu uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unaong'aa.
sw.R: Watu wengi wanauliza, "Ni nani atakayetupa mambo mema?" {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuangalie kwa wema na utufadhili.

es.L: Muchos [están] diciendo: «¿Quién nos mostrará el bien?». Alza sobre nosotros la luz de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Muchos dicen: «¿Quién nos dejará ver tiempos buenos?». {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, vuelve hacia nosotros {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro resplandeciente.
es.R: Mucha gente pregunta: «¿Quién nos dará cosas buenas?». {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sonríenos y sé bondadoso con nosotros.

decisions.choice: good: good times, a good harvest
decisions.reason: Good (tov) here is prosperity, the rain and harvest that verse 8 goes on to speak of.

decisions.choice: Lift up ...: the psalmist's prayer
alternatives: the rest of what the many say
decisions.reason: The question is what many are saying; the second line may continue their words or be the psalmist's answer. Since he goes on in verse 8 to speak to the LORD, the line is read as his prayer.

decisions.choice: the light of your face: the priestly blessing
decisions.reason: The words echo the blessing of Numbers 6:25-26: "the LORD make his face shine on you ... the LORD lift up his face on you". A shining face is God's favor.

decisions.choice: turn your shining face toward us (B); smile on us and be kind to us (R)
alternatives: lift up the light of your face on us
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the shining face; Readable says what it means (m3).

source.text: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: You have put joy in my heart, more than [at the] time their grain and their new wine abound.

en.L: You have put joy in my heart, more than [at the] time [when] their grain and their new wine abound.
en.B: The joy {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have put in my heart is greater than theirs at harvest, when grain and new wine overflow.
en.R: You have made me happier than people are at harvest time, when they have plenty of grain and wine.

fr.L: Tu as mis de la joie dans mon cœur, plus qu’[au] temps [où] leur blé et leur vin nouveau abondent.
fr.B: La joie que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mise dans mon cœur est plus grande que la leur à la moisson, quand le blé et le vin nouveau débordent.
fr.R: Tu m’as rendu plus heureux que les gens ne le sont au temps de la moisson, quand ils ont du blé et du vin en abondance.

sw.L: Umetia furaha moyoni mwangu, zaidi ya [wakati] nafaka yao na divai yao mpya zinapozidi.
sw.B: Furaha uliyoitia moyoni mwangu ni kubwa kuliko yao wakati wa mavuno, nafaka na divai mpya zinapofurika.
sw.R: Umenifurahisha kuliko watu wanavyofurahi wakati wa mavuno, wanapokuwa na nafaka na divai kwa wingi.

es.L: Tú has puesto alegría en mi corazón, más que [en el] tiempo [en que] abundan su grano y su mosto.
es.B: La alegría que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has puesto en mi corazón es mayor que la de ellos en la cosecha, cuando rebosan el grano y el vino nuevo.
es.R: Tú me has hecho más feliz que la gente en tiempo de cosecha, cuando tiene grano y vino en abundancia.

decisions.choice: grain and new wine: a rich harvest
decisions.reason: Grain and new wine (tirosh, the freshly pressed juice) are the harvest that God's blessing brings (Deuteronomy 7:13). "Their" is the many of verse 7, who look for good things.

decisions.choice: more than at the time: joy greater than theirs
decisions.reason: The joy God gives the psalmist is greater than the joy others have when the harvest is good.

decisions.choice: greater than theirs at harvest
alternatives: more than when their grain and new wine abound
decisions.reason: Balanced names the time the grain and wine come in (m1).

source.text: בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: In peace together I will lie down and sleep, for you, YHWH, alone, in safety make me dwell.

en.L: In peace together I will lie down and sleep, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, alone, in safety make me dwell.
en.B: I will lie down in peace and fall asleep at once, because it is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone, who let me live in safety.
en.R: When I lie down, I will go to sleep right away, feeling at peace, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, are the only one who keeps me safe.

fr.L: En paix, à la fois, je me coucherai et je dormirai, car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, seul, en sécurité {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fais demeurer.
fr.B: Je me coucherai en paix et je m’endormirai aussitôt, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul, qui me fais vivre en sécurité.
fr.R: Quand je me couche, je m’endors tout de suite, en paix, parce que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le seul à me garder en sécurité.

sw.L: Kwa amani nitajilaza pamoja na kulala, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, peke yako, unanikalisha salama.
sw.B: Nitajilaza kwa amani na kupata usingizi mara moja, kwa sababu ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke yako, unayeniwezesha kuishi salama.
sw.R: Ninapojilaza, nitalala usingizi mara moja nikiwa na amani, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndiye peke yako unayenilinda salama.

es.L: En paz a la vez me acostaré y dormiré, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, solo, en seguridad me haces habitar.
es.B: Me acostaré en paz y enseguida me dormiré, porque eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, quien me deja vivir seguro.
es.R: Cuando me acueste, me dormiré enseguida, sintiéndome en paz, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, eres el único que me mantiene a salvo.

decisions.choice: together: at once, both
decisions.reason: The word (yachdav) joins lying down and sleeping: he lies down and sleeps at once, without lying awake in fear (compare 3:6).

decisions.choice: alone: you alone
alternatives: though I am alone, you make me dwell in safety
decisions.reason: The word (levadad) most likely goes with "you": the LORD and no one else keeps him safe. It may instead describe the psalmist, safe though alone, as Israel "dwells in safety, alone" in Deuteronomy 33:28.

decisions.choice: peace: wholeness and safety
decisions.reason: Peace (shalom) is more than calm: it is well-being and safety, which the last line names.

decisions.choice: fall asleep at once (B); go to sleep right away (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "together" means here (m1).
